House for rent in Trends At Boca Raton22965 Old Inlet Bridge Dr, Boca Raton, FL 33433
The property boasts a newer roof and gutters as well as hurricane impact windows. Additionally, it features an energy-efficient two-stage air conditioner, ensuring year-round comfort. Downstairs features one bedroom and bathroom, living room/dinning room, family room, and kitchen. The upstairs has sleek laminate flooring, while the bathrooms are elegantly finished with marble. All bedrooms come with custom closets. Features include a ring alarm system, wifi thermostat, lighting, providing convenience at your fingertips. The large, fenced backyard features a stunning 600 sq. Ft. Travertine patio. Located in a well-maintained community with a community pool and tennis courts.
